context: Evaluates correct implementation of JWT authentication in Fastify using hooks, decorators, and TypeScript request augmentation. The candidate must use Fastify's lifecycle hooks to intercept and verify tokens, decorate the request with user context, and implement selective route protection and role-based access control.

checklist.name: Hook-based JWT verification
checklist.description: Uses app.addHook('onRequest') or app.addHook('preHandler') to intercept requests and verify the JWT — does not inline auth logic in each route handler

checklist.name: Request decoration with user
checklist.description: Uses app.decorateRequest('user', null) to declare the user property on requests and sets request.user after successful verification

checklist.name: HTTP 401 for missing/invalid token
checklist.description: Returns HTTP 401 (not 403 or 500) when the Authorization header is absent or the token fails verification

checklist.name: Selective route protection
checklist.description: Applies the authentication hook only to protected routes (not to public routes), using scoped plugin registration or per-route preHandler

checklist.name: Role-based HTTP 403
checklist.description: Returns HTTP 403 (not 401) when the token is valid but the user's role does not match the required role
